UCT remains Africa's top university

The University of Cape Town has achieved its highest overall score in a decade in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027, placing joint 147th globally. This also marks UCT’s highest position in the past six years.
Read more

Funding opportunities

Explore opportunities to fund your undergraduate and postgraduate studies at UCT. Discover information on the various bursaries and structured loans currently on offer.
Read more

and I want

UCT achieves its highest ranking in a decade – now in the top 3% globally

Africa’s leading university is ranked in the top 3% globally. Climbing to its highest position in 10 years in the recently released Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) World University Rankings, UCT is now in 150th place worldwide.

View our rankings

Study at UCT

UCT produces graduates whose qualifications are internationally recognised and locally applicable, underpinned by values of engaged citizenship and social justice.

Research & innovation news

UCT is committed to generating new knowledge in, for and from Africa. Our recent achievements include identifying a new heart-attack gene and a landmark restitution of human remains that allowed redress and social justice through science.
Read more

UCT and the Sustainable Development Goals

UCT is committed to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and contributes meaningfully to all 17 of them. As the leading university in Africa, we have a critical role to play in addressing global challenges through research.
Read more

A snapshot of research at UCT

Research at UCT is focused on addressing global challenges and realising both new opportunities within the social and natural world and new knowledge underpinning innovations of the future.
Read more

Short courses and lifelong learning

Unleash your potential by completing one – or more - of UCT’s short courses, workshops, seminars, lectures and conferences. These are offered in collaboration with the following UCT units and partners:

Virtual Campus Tour of UCT’s general spaces

Ready for an exclusive journey into the vibrant life of a University of Cape Town student? Join us on a thrilling 360° virtual tour which unlocks the most exciting and iconic spaces across UCT campuses.

#ChooseUCT

Faculty of Commerce Virtual Campus Tour

Join us on an exhilarating 360° virtual tour of the University of Cape Town’s (UCT) Faculty of Commerce where the future leaders of the business world are cultivated. If you’re eager to explore the pathways to business success then visit the Faculty of Commerce website for more information.

#ChooseUCT

Faculty of Engineering & the Built Environment Virtual Campus Tour

Embark on a riveting 360° virtual journey through the epicentre of innovation at the University of Cape Town’s (UCT) Faculty of Engineering & the Built Environment (EBE). If you want to explore the realm of ground-breaking ideas than visit the Faculty of Engineering & the Built Environment website for more information.

#ChooseUCT

Faculty of Health Sciences Virtual Campus Tour

Step into the forefront of medical excellence with our immersive 360° virtual tour of the University of Cape Town’s (UCT) Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS)! Ready to explore the epicentre of ground-breaking discoveries? Visit the Faculty of Health Sciences website for more information.

#ChooseUCT

Faculty of Humanities Virtual Campus Tour

Step into the immersive world of knowledge and creativity with our exclusive 360° virtual tour of the University of Cape Town’s (UCT) Faculty of Humanities. Embark on a journey spanning UCT’s Upper, Lower and Hiddingh campuses as we unveil the beating heart of intellectual exploration. Visit the Faculty of Humanities website for more information.

#ChooseUCT

Faculty of Law Virtual Campus Tour

Dive into the legal world with our virtual tour of UCT’s Faculty of Law, situated at UCT’s Middle campus. Experience the rich legacy of South Africa's oldest law faculty, ranked among the top 150 worldwide and leading in the continent! Visit the Faculty of Law website for more information about studying law at UCT.

#ChooseUCT

Faculty of Science Virtual Campus Tour

Join us on a virtual adventure through UCT's Faculty of Science, where we uncover the best spots to study, relax and connect. From high-tech labs to cozy study areas, this tour is your sneak peek into the Upper campus spaces that could shape your journey if you decide to dive into the world of science at UCT. Visit the Faculty of Science website for more information.

#ChooseUCT
